Others build their reputation by creating the infrastructure that makes modern life possible.Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) belongs to the second category.Established in 1956, BHEL emerged during a period when India was building the industrial capabilities required for a newly independent economy. Its core purpose was closely connected with the development of India
items.title_pt: BHEL: A história de engenharia indiana que ajudou a potencializar uma nação
items.summary_pt: Case de marca que construiu reputação criando a infraestrutura que torna a vida moderna possível, não apenas pela produção em massa.
